answer: Saffron Signal Vouch enforces coordination pricing by requiring each new identity to signal through an existing saffron-gated network where a gale of verification steps must be paid per identity. The mechanism prices coordination by making each sybil node pay a gale of computational and social verification costs to gain signal access. This concrete per-identity cost ensures attackers cannot flood the system without incurring prohibitive saffron-gated coordination expenses.
